SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  DATE_DIFF(
    SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_txn_date, 7, 2) AS DATE),
    SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(first_visit_date, 7, 2) AS DATE),
    DAY
  ) AS days_elapsed,
  deviceCategory
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0 THEN date END) AS first_txn_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0 THEN device.deviceCategory END) AS deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  HAVING first_txn_date IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY fullVisitorId

-- Final query: top traffic source by total product revenue in first half of 2017,
-- with max daily, weekly, and monthly product revenues for that source
WITH product_revenue_by_source AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS total_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) h,
  UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT traffic_source
  FROM product_revenue_by_source
  ORDER BY total_revenue_millions DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    date AS day,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) h,
  UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, date
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) h,
  UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, week_start
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) h,
  UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, month_start
)
SELECT 
  ts.traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(dr.daily_revenue_millions) FROM daily_revenue dr WHERE dr.source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(wr.weekly_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_revenue wr WHERE wr.source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(mr.monthly_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_revenue mr WHERE mr.source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM top_source ts

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) as session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as session_month,
    totals.transactions,
    totals.pageviews,
    (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    session_month,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE transactions >= 1 OR transactions IS NULL
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

WITH all_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, 
         h.hitNumber, h.time, 
         h.page.pagePath AS pagePath,
         h.type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
       UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_hits
  WHERE pagePath = '/home'
),
next_page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    h.fullVisitorId, h.visitId, h.hitNumber AS home_hitNumber,
    h.time AS home_time,
    nh.hitNumber AS next_hitNumber,
    nh.time AS next_time,
    nh.pagePath AS next_path
  FROM home_hits h
  LEFT JOIN all_hits nh 
    ON h.fullVisitorId = nh.fullVisitorId 
    AND h.visitId = nh.visitId
    AND nh.hitNumber = h.hitNumber + 1
    AND nh.type = 'PAGE'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_path, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM next_page_hits
  WHERE next_path IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_path
),
top_next_page AS (
  SELECT next_path
  FROM next_page_counts
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time_calc AS (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(next_time - home_time) AS INT64) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM next_page_hits
  WHERE next_path IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.next_path AS most_common_next_page, m.max_time_seconds
FROM top_next_page t, max_time_calc m

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000.0, 2) as difference_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.v2ProductName = "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
),
all_purchases AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM customers c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s ON c.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) as total_quantity
FROM all_purchases
WHERE v2ProductName != "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day
WHERE user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    cumulative_confirmed,
    LAG(cumulative_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_cumulative
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd
FROM daily
WHERE prev_cumulative > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed, prev_cumulative) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  trip_quantile,
  CAST(ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS INT64) as min_trip_minutes,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS INT64) as max_trip_minutes,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  AVG(fare) as avg_fare
FROM (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) as trip_quantile,
    trip_seconds / 60.0 as trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
)
GROUP BY trip_quantile
ORDER BY trip_quantile

WITH ny_donors AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    transaction_amt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20`
  WHERE state = 'NY'
    AND zip_code IS NOT NULL
    AND transaction_amt IS NOT NULL
),
kings_crosswalk AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    census_tract_geoid
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts`
  WHERE census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_donations AS (
  SELECT 
    k.census_tract_geoid,
    AVG(n.transaction_amt) as avg_donation
  FROM ny_donors n
  JOIN kings_crosswalk k ON n.zip_code = k.zip_code
  GROUP BY k.census_tract_geoid
)
SELECT 
  td.census_tract_geoid,
  td.avg_donation,
  c.median_income
FROM tract_donations td
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` c
  ON SUBSTR(c.geo_id, 1, 11) = td.census_tract_geoid
ORDER BY td.census_tract_geoid

-- Alternative: Filter to evaluation groups specifically for 2012
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) AS subplot_acres,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) AS macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND CAST(p.evaluation_group AS STRING) LIKE '%2012'
  GROUP BY 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
),
top_per_group AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, evaluation_type, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code, subplot_acres, macroplot_acres
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT evaluation_group_description AS evaluation_group, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, evaluation_description, 
       CAST(state_code AS STRING) AS state_code, 
       ROUND(macroplot_acres, 2) AS macroplot_acres, 
       ROUND(subplot_acres, 2) AS subplot_acres
FROM top_per_group
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    (SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS temp_c,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS temp_ma8,
    AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prcp_ma8,
    AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM daily_data
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
  ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
  ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
  ROUND(temp_ma8, 1) AS temp_ma8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8, 1) AS prcp_ma8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8, 1) AS wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff1,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff2,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff3,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff4,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff5,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff6,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff7,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff8
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 12

SELECT
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ATAN2(
      SQRT(
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) +
        COS(SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2)
      ),
      SQRT(1 - (
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) +
        COS(SAFE_CAST(s.latitude AS FLOAT64) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(SAFE_CAST(e.latitude AS FLOAT64) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
        SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2) * SIN((SAFE_CAST(s.longitude AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST(e.longitude AS FLOAT64)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2)
      ))
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` e ON t.end_station_id = e.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

-- Use station_id as the grouping key for proportions, pick most common name
WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    starttime,
    stoptime,
    bikeid,
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(
      TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(starttime, HOUR, "UTC"),
      INTERVAL (DIV(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime), 2) * 2) MINUTE
    ) as bucket_2min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    bucket_2min,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM same_station
  GROUP BY start_station_id, bucket_2min
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.start_station_id,
    CASE WHEN bc.cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_group
  FROM same_station ss
  JOIN bucket_counts bc 
    ON ss.start_station_id = bc.start_station_id 
    AND ss.bucket_2min = bc.bucket_2min
),
station_group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SUM(is_group) as group_rides
  FROM group_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id
),
station_total_end AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
  )
)
SELECT 
  s.end_station_id as station_id,
  sn.end_station_name as station_name,
  s.total_trips,
  COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0) as group_rides,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0), s.total_trips), 6) as proportion
FROM station_total_end s
JOIN station_names sn ON s.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id AND sn.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN station_group_counts g ON s.end_station_id = g.start_station_id
WHERE s.total_trips > 0
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', date) as month,
  '52003' as zip_code,
  SUM(volume_sold_liters) / 9882.0 as monthly_per_capita_liters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
WHERE county = 'DUBUQUE'
  AND date >= '2022-01-01' AND date < '2023-01-01'
  AND category_name = 'STRAIGHT BOURBON WHISKIES'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH precip AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(value) / 10.0 AS total_precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND mflag IS NULL AND qflag IS NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
weather AS (
  SELECT date,
    CASE WHEN total_precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS weather_condition
  FROM precip
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT DATE(starttime) AS trip_date, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY trip_date
)
SELECT w.weather_condition,
  AVG(d.trip_count) AS avg_daily_trips
FROM weather w
JOIN daily_trips d ON w.date = d.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition
ORDER BY w.weather_condition

WITH live_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS live_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE UPPER(status) != 'DEAD'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != 'PLANTING SITE'
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES'
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES'
    AND spc_latin != 'STUMP'
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
alive_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS alive_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE UPPER(status) = 'ALIVE'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_info AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) AS species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
)
SELECT 
  si.fall_color,
  SUM(COALESCE(a2015.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(l1995.live_count, 0)) AS total_change
FROM species_info si
LEFT JOIN live_1995 l1995 ON si.species_upper = l1995.species_upper
LEFT JOIN alive_2015 a2015 ON si.species_upper = a2015.species_upper
WHERE si.fall_color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY si.fall_color

-- Full proportional allocation query with proper rounding
WITH tract_zip_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    z.zip_code,
    a.total_pop as tract_total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    a.total_pop * a.income_per_capita as tract_total_income,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) as overlap_area,
    ST_AREA(t.tract_geom) as tract_area,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(t.tract_geom)) as area_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    ON a.geo_id = t.geo_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '53%'
    AND z.state_code = 'WA'
    AND ST_DWITHIN(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833), 5 * 1609.344)
    AND ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
allocated AS (
  SELECT
    zip_code,
    tract_total_pop * area_ratio as allocated_pop,
    tract_total_income * area_ratio as allocated_income
  FROM tract_zip_overlap
)
SELECT
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 1) as total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM allocated
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH births AS (

  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)

),
pct AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    county_fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(births_no_morbidity, total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM births
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
merged AS (
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM merged
  WHERE poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_r
FROM stats
ORDER BY birth_year

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`

person_counts AS (

primary_vehicle AS (

WITH latest_eval AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY p.state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.expansion_factor, 
         p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
         p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
         p.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         p.evaluation_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_eval le ON p.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.latest_seq
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT c.plot_sequence_number, c.state_code, c.state_code_name,
         c.condition_status_code, c.reserved_status_code, c.site_productivity_class_code,
         c.proportion_basis, c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
         fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
         fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
         fp.expansion_factor,
         fp.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         fp.evaluation_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN filtered_pop fp ON c.plot_sequence_number = fp.plot_sequence_number 
    AND c.state_code = fp.state_code
),
state_acres AS (
  SELECT state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         SUM(CASE 
           WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
             THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
           WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
             THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE 0
         END) as acres
  FROM combined
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1 
    AND reserved_status_code = 0
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number, acres,

  FROM state_acres
),
forestland_acres AS (

         SUM(CASE 
           WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0

           WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
             THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE 0
         END) as acres
  FROM combined
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
  GROUP BY state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group, evaluation_group_sequence_number, acres,

WITH contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS obs_00,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS obs_01,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS obs_10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS obs_11,
    SUM(cnt) AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT has_kras, has_tp53, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        p.bcr_patient_uuid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_kras,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_tp53
      FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup` p
      LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m 
        ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
        AND m.Study = 'PAAD' 
        AND m.Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
      WHERE p.acronym = 'PAAD'
      GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_uuid
    )
    GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
  )
),
expected AS (
  SELECT 
    obs_00, obs_01, obs_10, obs_11, total,
    -- Row totals
    obs_00 + obs_01 AS row0_total,
    obs_10 + obs_11 AS row1_total,
    -- Column totals
    obs_00 + obs_10 AS col0_total,
    obs_01 + obs_11 AS col1_total,
    -- Expected values
    (obs_00 + obs_01) * (obs_00 + obs_10) * 1.0 / total AS exp_00,
    (obs_00 + obs_01) * (obs_01 + obs_11) * 1.0 / total AS exp_01,
    (obs_10 + obs_11) * (obs_00 + obs_10) * 1.0 / total AS exp_10,
    (obs_10 + obs_11) * (obs_01 + obs_11) * 1.0 / total AS exp_11
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT 
  obs_00, obs_01, obs_10, obs_11, total,
  exp_00, exp_01, exp_10, exp_11,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(obs_00 - exp_00, 2), exp_00) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(obs_01 - exp_01, 2), exp_01) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(obs_10 - exp_10, 2), exp_10) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(obs_11 - exp_11, 2), exp_11) AS chi_squared
FROM expected

WITH filtered_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cy.RefNo, cy.CaseNo
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cy
    WHERE cy.Morph = '3111' OR cy.Topo = '0401'
),
sample_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_samples FROM filtered_samples
),
band_events AS (
    SELECT 
        b.chromosome,
        b.cytoband_name,
        b.hg38_start,
        b.hg38_stop,
        c.ChrOrd,
        0 as amplifications,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Type = 'Gain' THEN CONCAT(c.RefNo, '_', c.CaseNo) END) as gains,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Type = 'Loss' THEN CONCAT(c.RefNo, '_', c.CaseNo) END) as losses,
        0 as homozygous_deletions
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
    JOIN filtered_samples fs ON c.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` b 
        ON c.Chr = b.chromosome 
        AND c.Start < b.hg38_stop 
        AND c.End > b.hg38_start
    GROUP BY b.chromosome, b.cytoband_name, b.hg38_start, b.hg38_stop, c.ChrOrd
)
SELECT 
    be.chromosome,
    be.cytoband_name,
    be.hg38_start,
    be.hg38_stop,
    be.ChrOrd,
    be.amplifications,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(be.amplifications * 100.0, sc.total_samples), 2) as amplifications_freq,
    be.gains,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(be.gains * 100.0, sc.total_samples), 2) as gains_freq,
    be.losses,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(be.losses * 100.0, sc.total_samples), 2) as losses_freq,
    be.homozygous_deletions,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(be.homozygous_deletions * 100.0, sc.total_samples), 2) as homozygous_deletions_freq
FROM band_events be
CROSS JOIN sample_counts sc
ORDER BY be.ChrOrd, be.hg38_start

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.RefNo, a.CaseNo, a.InvNo, a.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss a
  JOIN chr17_loss b ON a.RefNo = b.RefNo AND a.CaseNo = b.CaseNo AND a.InvNo = b.InvNo AND a.Clone = b.Clone
  JOIN chr11_gain c ON a.RefNo = c.RefNo AND a.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND a.InvNo = c.InvNo AND a.Clone = c.Clone
),
full_details AS (
  SELECT m.RefNo, m.CaseNo, m.InvNo, m.Clone,
         c13.ChrOrd AS Chr13Ord, c13.Start AS Chr13Start, c13.`End` AS Chr13End,
         c17.ChrOrd AS Chr17Ord, c17.Start AS Chr17Start, c17.`End` AS Chr17End,
         c11.ChrOrd AS Chr11Ord, c11.Start AS Chr11Start, c11.`End` AS Chr11End,
         k.CloneShort
  FROM matching_clones m
  JOIN chr13_loss c13 ON m.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND m.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND m.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND m.Clone = c13.Clone
  JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON m.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND m.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND m.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND m.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON m.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND m.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND m.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND m.Clone = c11.Clone
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` k ON m.RefNo = k.RefNo AND m.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND m.InvNo = k.InvNo AND m.Clone = k.CloneNo
)
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM full_details
ORDER BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc,
    MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', start_date)) AS min_duration_sec,
    MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', start_date)) AS max_duration_sec
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) AS first_trip_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) AS last_trip_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(max_duration_sec), 60) AS highest_trip_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(min_duration_sec), 60) AS lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM ranked
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH all_games AS (
  SELECT gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'REG' AND homeTeamName NOT IN ('American League', 'National League')
  GROUP BY gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'PST'
  GROUP BY gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName
),
lineup_players AS (
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId as teamId, lineupPlayerId as playerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'REG' AND inningEventType = 'LINEUP' AND lineupPlayerId IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId as teamId, lineupPlayerId as playerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'PST' AND inningEventType = 'LINEUP' AND lineupPlayerId IS NOT NULL
),
pitch_data AS (
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'REG' AND inningEventType = 'AT_BAT' AND pitcherId IS NOT NULL AND pitchSpeed > 0
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'PST' AND inningEventType = 'AT_BAT' AND pitcherId IS NOT NULL AND pitchSpeed > 0
),
pitcher_team AS (
  SELECT pg.gameId, pg.homeTeamId, pg.homeTeamName, pg.awayTeamId, pg.awayTeamName,
         pd.pitcherId, pd.pitcherFirstName, pd.pitcherLastName, pd.pitchSpeed
  FROM all_games pg
  JOIN pitch_data pd ON pg.gameId = pd.gameId
  LEFT JOIN lineup_players lp_home ON pg.gameId = lp_home.gameId AND pd.pitcherId = lp_home.playerId AND lp_home.teamId = pg.homeTeamId
  LEFT JOIN lineup_players lp_away ON pg.gameId = lp_away.gameId AND pd.pitcherId = lp_away.playerId AND lp_away.teamId = pg.awayTeamId
  WHERE lp_home.teamId IS NOT NULL OR lp_away.teamId IS NOT NULL
),
pitcher_team_assignment AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN pt_lp_home.teamId IS NOT NULL THEN pt.homeTeamId ELSE pt.awayTeamId END as teamId,
    CASE WHEN pt_lp_home.teamId IS NOT NULL THEN pt.homeTeamName ELSE pt.awayTeamName END as teamName,
    pt.pitcherId, pt.pitcherFirstName, pt.pitcherLastName, pt.pitchSpeed
  FROM pitcher_team pt
  LEFT JOIN lineup_players pt_lp_home ON pt.gameId = pt_lp_home.gameId AND pt.pitcherId = pt_lp_home.playerId AND pt_lp_home.teamId = pt.homeTeamId
  LEFT JOIN lineup_players pt_lp_away ON pt.gameId = pt_lp_away.gameId AND pt.pitcherId = pt_lp_away.playerId AND pt_lp_away.teamId = pt.awayTeamId
),
pitcher_team_max AS (
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_speed
  FROM pitcher_team_assignment
  GROUP BY teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY teamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) as rn
  FROM pitcher_team_max
)
SELECT teamName, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY teamName

WITH top_station AS (

station_trips AS (

WITH total_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
stations_with_ada_entrances AS (
  SELECT 
    s.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS ada_station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
  GROUP BY s.borough_name
)
SELECT 
  t.borough_name,
  t.total_stations,
  COALESCE(a.ada_station_count, 0) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(a.ada_station_count, 0), t.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM total_stations t
LEFT JOIN stations_with_ada_entrances a
  ON t.borough_name = a.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH stations_near_chappaqua AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name, state, lat, lon,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) as distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'NY'
    AND lat != 0.0 AND lon != 0.0
    AND ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) <= 20 * 1609.344
),
temp_counts AS (
  SELECT stn, wban, COUNT(*) as valid_temp_observations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY stn, wban
)
SELECT 
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  s.name,
  s.lat,
  s.lon,
  ROUND(s.distance_meters / 1609.344, 2) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(tc.valid_temp_observations, 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_near_chappaqua s
LEFT JOIN temp_counts tc
  ON s.usaf = tc.stn AND s.wban = tc.wban
ORDER BY s.distance_meters

    item_description,
    SUM(sale_dollars) as total_sales_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2022

  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
),
sales_2023 AS (

    SUM(sale_dollars) as total_sales_2023

  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2023

  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)

  a.item_number,

  a.total_sales_2022,
  b.total_sales_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(b.total_sales_2023 - a.total_sales_2022, a.total_sales_2022) * 100 as yoy_growth_pct

WITH yearly_totals AS (

),
category_yearly AS (

  GROUP BY year, minor_category
),
ranked AS (

  year,
  minor_category,

  total_crimes,

WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as date,
    s.country,
    AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) as avg_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31' AND g.year = '2023'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), s.country
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(max_US - max_UK, 1) as diff_max_temp,
  ROUND(min_US - min_UK, 1) as diff_min_temp,

FROM daily_stats
PIVOT(

WITH all_trips AS (
  -- 2014 data for lookback periods
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    z.zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as pickup_hour,
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM t.pickup_datetime) as pickup_date,
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(t.pickup_datetime, HOUR) as hour_ts
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2014` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2014-12-11' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude != 0 AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
  UNION ALL
  -- 2015 data for Jan 1
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    z.zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as pickup_hour,
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM t.pickup_datetime) as pickup_date,
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(t.pickup_datetime, HOUR) as hour_ts
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude != 0 AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    pickup_hour,
    pickup_date,
    hour_ts,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM all_trips
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour, pickup_date, hour_ts
),
all_hours AS (
  SELECT hour_val
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) as hour_val
),
all_zips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
),
cross_join AS (
  SELECT az.zip_code, h.hour_val as pickup_hour
  FROM all_zips az
  JOIN all_hours h ON TRUE
),
jan1_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
-- 1 hour ago: for hour H, look at hour H-1 (with wrap: hour 0 looks at Dec 31 23:00)
-- We need to shift: for each hour H, the 1hr-ago count is at hour (H-1) mod 24
-- For H=0: Dec 31 23:00 → zip_code, hour 23
-- For H=1: Jan 1 00:00 → zip_code, hour 0
-- For H=2: Jan 1 01:00 → zip_code, hour 1
-- etc.
-- So for each (zip_code, H), count_1hr_ago = count at (zip_code, H-1 mod 24) on Jan 1 (or Dec 31 for H=0)
lookback_1hr AS (
  -- For hour 0: look at Dec 31 hour 23
  SELECT zip_code, 0 as pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as count_1hr_ago
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2014-12-31' AND pickup_hour = 23
  GROUP BY zip_code
  UNION ALL
  -- For hours 1-23: look at Jan 1 at hour (H-1)
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour + 1 as pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as count_1hr_ago
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2015-01-01' AND pickup_hour >= 0 AND pickup_hour <= 22
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
-- 1 day ago: Dec 31 at the same hour
lookback_1day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as count_1day_ago
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2014-12-31'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
-- 7 days ago: Dec 25 at the same hour
lookback_7day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as count_7days_ago
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2014-12-25'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
-- 14 days ago: Dec 18 at the same hour
lookback_14day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour, SUM(trip_count) as count_14days_ago
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date = '2014-12-18'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
moving_14day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as ma_14day
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date >= '2014-12-18' AND pickup_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
),
moving_21day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, pickup_hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as ma_21day,
    STDDEV_POP(trip_count) as std_21day
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE pickup_date >= '2014-12-11' AND pickup_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, pickup_hour
)
SELECT 
  cj.zip_code,
  cj.pickup_hour,
  COALESCE(j.total_trips, 0) as total_trips,
  COALESCE(l1.count_1hr_ago, 0) as count_1hr_ago,
  COALESCE(l2.count_1day_ago, 0) as count_1day_ago,
  COALESCE(l7.count_7days_ago, 0) as count_7days_ago,
  COALESCE(l14.count_14days_ago, 0) as count_14days_ago,
  ROUND(m14.ma_14day, 2) as ma_14day,
  ROUND(m21.ma_21day, 2) as ma_21day,
  ROUND(m21.std_21day, 2) as std_21day
FROM cross_join cj
LEFT JOIN jan1_counts j ON cj.zip_code = j.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = j.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN lookback_1hr l1 ON cj.zip_code = l1.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = l1.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN lookback_1day l2 ON cj.zip_code = l2.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = l2.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN lookback_7day l7 ON cj.zip_code = l7.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = l7.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN lookback_14day l14 ON cj.zip_code = l14.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = l14.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN moving_14day m14 ON cj.zip_code = m14.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = m14.pickup_hour
LEFT JOIN moving_21day m21 ON cj.zip_code = m21.zip_code AND cj.pickup_hour = m21.pickup_hour
ORDER BY total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creation_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tags LIKE '%python%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS python_questions,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN tags LIKE '%python%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) AS proportion
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2022
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creation_date)
ORDER BY month

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    tags,
    view_count,
    title,
    body,
    CASE 
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-layout%' THEN 'android-layout'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-activity%' THEN 'android-activity'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-intent%' THEN 'android-intent'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' THEN 'android-edittext'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' THEN 'android-fragments'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' THEN 'android-recyclerview'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%listview%' THEN 'listview'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' THEN 'android-actionbar'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%google-maps%' THEN 'google-maps'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%' THEN 'android-asynctask'
    END AS tag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE (LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%how%')
    AND NOT (LOWER(title) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%trouble%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%trouble%')
    AND (tags LIKE '%android-layout%' OR tags LIKE '%android-activity%' OR tags LIKE '%android-intent%' OR tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' OR tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' OR tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' OR tags LIKE '%listview%' OR tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' OR tags LIKE '%google-maps%' OR tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%')
),
tag_counts AS (
  SELECT tag, COUNT(*) as tag_question_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY tag
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
)
SELECT f.tag, f.id, f.view_count, f.title
FROM filtered f
JOIN tag_counts tc ON f.tag = tc.tag
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.tag ORDER BY f.view_count DESC) <= 50
ORDER BY f.tag, f.view_count DESC

WITH q AS (
  SELECT id, owner_user_id as question_owner_id, view_count, accepted_answer_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
),
a AS (
  SELECT id, parent_id, owner_user_id as answer_owner_id, score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
),
q_a AS (
  SELECT q.id as question_id, q.question_owner_id, q.view_count, q.accepted_answer_id, 
         a.id as answer_id, a.answer_owner_id, a.score
  FROM q
  LEFT JOIN a ON a.parent_id = q.id
),
total_scores AS (
  SELECT question_id, SUM(score) as total_answer_score
  FROM q_a
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT qa.question_id, qa.question_owner_id, qa.view_count, qa.accepted_answer_id, 
         qa.answer_id, qa.answer_owner_id, qa.score, ts.total_answer_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY qa.question_id ORDER BY qa.score DESC, qa.answer_id ASC) as answer_rank
  FROM q_a qa
  LEFT JOIN total_scores ts ON ts.question_id = qa.question_id
),
associated_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, question_owner_id as user_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE question_owner_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_id = accepted_answer_id AND answer_owner_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL AND score > 5 AND answer_owner_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND score > 0 
    AND total_answer_score > 0
    AND score > 0.2 * total_answer_score
    AND answer_owner_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_rank <= 3 AND answer_owner_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ap.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  SAFE_CAST(SUM(q.view_count) AS INT64) as total_view_count
FROM associated_pairs ap
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON q.id = ap.question_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON u.id = ap.user_id
GROUP BY ap.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH questions_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM creation_date) as dow_num,
    id as question_id,
    creation_date as question_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-01-01'
),
answered AS (
  SELECT 
    q.question_id,
    q.dow_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.creation_date >= q.question_date 
             AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.creation_date, q.question_date, SECOND) <= 3600 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as answered_within_1hr
  FROM questions_2021 q
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.question_id = a.parent_id
  GROUP BY q.question_id, q.dow_num
)
SELECT 
  CASE dow_num
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'
  END as day_name,
  COUNT(*) as total_questions,
  SUM(answered_within_1hr) as answered_within_1hr,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(answered_within_1hr), COUNT(*)) * 100 as percentage
FROM answered
GROUP BY dow_num
ORDER BY dow_num

WITH health_2017 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS health_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2017
),
health_2018 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS health_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2018
),
pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017,
    year_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2017 > 0 AND year_2018 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop p
JOIN health_2017 h2017 ON p.country_code = h2017.country_code
JOIN health_2018 h2018 ON p.country_code = h2018.country_code
WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(p.year_2018 - p.year_2017, p.year_2017) > 0.01
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h2018.health_2018 - h2017.health_2017, h2017.health_2017) > 0.01
  AND p.country_code NOT IN (
    'LMC','EAR','WLD','PSS','TSA','SAS','IBT','MIC','LMY','LIC','HIC','IDA','IDB','IDX','HPC','FCS','LDC','LTE','NAC','EUU','ECS','MEA','AFE','ARB','CEB','ECA','EAP','AFW','LCN','CSS','MNA','SSF','TSS'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) as count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_intl_debt.international_debt`
WHERE country_name = 'Russian Federation'
  AND value = 0

WITH latest_gdp AS (
  SELECT country_code, value as gdp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD' AND year = 2020
),
country_regions AS (
  SELECT country_code, region
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.country_summary`
  WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND region != ''
),
combined AS (
  SELECT cr.region, lg.gdp
  FROM latest_gdp lg
  JOIN country_regions cr ON lg.country_code = cr.country_code
)
SELECT 
  region,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(gdp, 2)[OFFSET(1)] as median_gdp
FROM combined
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY median_gdp DESC

WITH monthly_usage AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month_num,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS customer_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_seconds
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(end_date)) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month_num
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    SUM(customer_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS cumulative_customer_seconds,
    SUM(subscriber_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS cumulative_subscriber_seconds
  FROM monthly_usage
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ABS(cumulative_customer_seconds - cumulative_subscriber_seconds) / 60000.0 AS abs_diff_thousands_minutes
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY abs_diff_thousands_minutes DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT 141095 as ancestor_concept_id, 141095 as descendant_concept_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 133834, 133834
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 140168, 140168
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 138502, 138502
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_concept_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM snomed_descendants d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr

  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
icd10_mapping AS (
  SELECT 141095 as snomed_concept_id, 1569798 as icd10_concept_id, 'L70' as icd10_code, 'Acne' as condition_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 133834, 1569765, 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 140168, 1569777, 'L40', 'Psoriasis'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 138502, 35208655, 'L80', 'Vitiligo'
),
all_snomed_concepts AS (
  SELECT im.icd10_code, im.condition_name, sd.descendant_concept_id as condition_concept_id
  FROM snomed_descendants sd
  JOIN icd10_mapping im ON sd.ancestor_concept_id = im.snomed_concept_id

participant_counts AS (

  GROUP BY asc_icd.icd10_code, asc_icd.condition_name
),
total_participants AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)
SELECT pc.icd10_code, pc.condition_name, pc.participant_count, tp.total,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.participant_count, tp.total) * 100 as percentage
FROM participant_counts pc

WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization as specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT npi) as distinct_npi_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name = 'MOUNTAIN VIEW'
    AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
    AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization IS NOT NULL
    AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization != ''
  GROUP BY healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_count FROM top10
)
SELECT t.specialization, t.distinct_npi_count, a.avg_count,
       ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_count) as diff_from_avg

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds >= 60 AND trip_seconds <= 3000
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) as quantile_group
  FROM trips
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    quantile_group,
    MIN(trip_minutes) as min_minutes,
    MAX(trip_minutes) as max_minutes,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips,
    AVG(fare) as avg_fare
  FROM with_quantile
  GROUP BY quantile_group
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(min_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(max_minutes AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') as time_range,
  total_trips,
  ROUND(avg_fare, 2) as avg_fare
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY min_minutes

WITH label_counts AS (
  SELECT o.period, la.description as label, COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) as artwork_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.the_met.objects` o
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.the_met.vision_api_data` v ON o.object_id = v.object_id
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(v.labelAnnotations) as la
  WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL AND o.period != ''
  GROUP BY o.period, la.description
  HAVING artwork_count >= 500
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT period, label, artwork_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY artwork_count DESC) as rn
  FROM label_counts
)
SELECT period, label, artwork_count

-- Final query: Top 3 lowest-level pathways with TAS evidence by chi-squared
WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID as uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e 
    ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND i.expID IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
target_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT uniprot_id FROM sorafenib_targets)
),
target_pe_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stable_id) as total_targets
  FROM target_pe
),
all_tas_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ptep.pe_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptep
  WHERE ptep.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
non_target_pe AS (
  SELECT pe_stable_id
  FROM all_tas_pe
  WHERE pe_stable_id NOT IN (SELECT stable_id FROM target_pe)
),
non_target_pe_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe_stable_id) as total_non_targets
  FROM non_target_pe
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT total_targets FROM target_pe_count) as total_targets,
    (SELECT total_non_targets FROM non_target_pe_count) as total_non_targets
),
lowest_tas_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ptep.pathway_stable_id, p.name as pathway_name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptep
  INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ptep.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE ptep.evidence_code = 'TAS'
  AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ptep.pathway_stable_id, ptep.pe_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptep
  WHERE ptep.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathway_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ltp.pathway_stable_id,
    ltp.pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ppe.pe_stable_id END) as targets_in,
    tc.total_targets - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ppe.pe_stable_id END) as targets_out,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ntp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ppe.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_in,
    tc.total_non_targets - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ntp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ppe.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_out
  FROM lowest_tas_pathways ltp
  INNER JOIN total_counts tc ON TRUE
  INNER JOIN pathway_pe ppe ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = ltp.pathway_stable_id
  LEFT JOIN target_pe tp ON ppe.pe_stable_id = tp.stable_id
  LEFT JOIN non_target_pe ntp ON ppe.pe_stable_id = ntp.pe_stable_id
  GROUP BY ltp.pathway_stable_id, ltp.pathway_name, tc.total_targets, tc.total_non_targets
),
pathway_chi2 AS (
  SELECT 
    pathway_stable_id,
    pathway_name,
    targets_in,
    targets_out,
    non_targets_in,
    non_targets_out,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (targets_in + targets_out + non_targets_in + non_targets_out) * 
      POW(targets_in * non_targets_out - targets_out * non_targets_in, 2),
      (targets_in + targets_out) * (non_targets_in + non_targets_out) * 
      (targets_in + non_targets_in) * (targets_out + non_targets_out)
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_stats
  WHERE (targets_in + targets_out) > 0 
    AND (non_targets_in + non_targets_out) > 0
    AND (targets_in + non_targets_in) > 0
    AND (targets_out + non_targets_out) > 0
)
SELECT 
  pathway_stable_id,
  pathway_name,
  chi_squared,
  targets_in,
  targets_out,
  non_targets_in,
  non_targets_out
FROM pathway_chi2
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    SAFE_CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as standard_value,

    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) as pchembl_value,
    a.potential_duplicate,

    cs.canonical_smiles

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
    ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
    ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_value != ''
),
mol_act_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, COUNT(*) as act_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 5
),
mol_dup_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 2
),
valid_activities AS (
  SELECT fa.*
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN mol_act_counts mac ON fa.assay_id = mac.assay_id AND fa.standard_type = mac.standard_type AND fa.molregno = mac.molregno
  JOIN mol_dup_counts mdc ON fa.assay_id = mdc.assay_id AND fa.standard_type = mdc.standard_type AND fa.molregno = mdc.molregno
),
valid_assay_types AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type
  FROM valid_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) >= 2
),
final_activities AS (
  SELECT va.*
  FROM valid_activities va
  JOIN valid_assay_types vat ON va.assay_id = vat.assay_id AND va.standard_type = vat.standard_type
),
docs_with_date AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) IS NOT NULL THEN SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) ELSE 1970 END as pub_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64)) > 1 
      THEN CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) - 1 AS FLOAT64) / (COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64)) - 1)
      ELSE 0.0 
    END as percent_rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    pub_year,
    CAST(FLOOR(percent_rank * 11) AS INT64) + 1 as month_num,
    CAST(FLOOR(percent_rank * 308) AS INT64) - CAST(FLOOR(percent_rank * 308) / 28.0 * 28 AS INT64) + 1 as day_num
  FROM docs_with_date
),
activity_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    fa1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
    fa2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
    fa1.assay_id,
    fa1.standard_type,
    fa1.molregno as molregno_1,
    fa2.molregno as molregno_2,
    fa1.standard_value as sv1,
    fa2.standard_value as sv2,
    fa1.standard_relation as sr1,
    fa2.standard_relation as sr2,
    fa1.heavy_atoms as ha1,
    fa2.heavy_atoms as ha2,
    fa1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
    fa2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
    fa1.canonical_smiles as smiles_1,
    fa2.canonical_smiles as smiles_2
  FROM final_activities fa1
  JOIN final_activities fa2
    ON fa1.assay_id = fa2.assay_id
    AND fa1.standard_type = fa2.standard_type
    AND fa1.molregno < fa2.molregno
),
pair_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    ap.*,
    dd1.pub_year as py1, dd1.month_num as mn1, dd1.day_num as dn1,
    dd2.pub_year as py2, dd2.month_num as mn2, dd2.day_num as dn2
  FROM activity_pairs ap
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd1 ON ap.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd2 ON ap.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
),
latest_date AS (
  SELECT 
    activity_id_1,
    activity_id_2,
    CASE 
      WHEN (COALESCE(py2, 0) > COALESCE(py1, 0)) 
        OR (COALESCE(py2, 0) = COALESCE(py1, 0) AND COALESCE(mn2, 0) > COALESCE(mn1, 0))
        OR (COALESCE(py2, 0) = COALESCE(py1, 0) AND COALESCE(mn2, 0) = COALESCE(mn1, 0) AND COALESCE(dn2, 0) > COALESCE(dn1, 0))
      THEN CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(py2, 1970) AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(mn2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(dn2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(py1, 1970) AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(mn1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(dn1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END as latest_pub_date
  FROM pair_with_dates
)
SELECT 
  pd.activity_id_1,
  pd.activity_id_2,
  GREATEST(pd.ha1, pd.ha2) as max_heavy_atoms,
  ld.latest_pub_date,
  GREATEST(pd.doc_id_1, pd.doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN pd.sv1 > pd.sv2 THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN pd.sv1 < pd.sv2 THEN 'increase'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END as change_classification,
  TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(pd.activity_id_1, pd.activity_id_2)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
FROM pair_with_dates pd
JOIN latest_date ld ON pd.activity_id_1 = ld.activity_id_1 AND pd.activity_id_2 = ld.activity_id_2

-- Final query: Week 2 retention for new users, cohorts July 9 through September 17, 2018
WITH all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_first_touch_timestamp,
    event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_first_touch_timestamp,
    MIN(event_date) as first_session_start_date
  FROM all_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
),
user_with_touch_date AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_start_date,
    user_first_touch_timestamp,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) as touch_date
  FROM user_first
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_start_date,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_start_date) as session_date
  FROM user_with_touch_date
  WHERE first_session_start_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', touch_date)
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    session_date,
    DATE_SUB(session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM session_date) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM new_users
),
user_week2 AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    cohort_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 14 DAY) as week2_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 20 DAY) as week2_sunday
  FROM user_cohort
),
user_retained AS (
  SELECT 
    uw.user_pseudo_id,
    uw.cohort_monday,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(s.event_date) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM user_week2 uw
  LEFT JOIN all_sessions s 
    ON uw.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id 
    AND s.event_date >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', uw.week2_monday)
    AND s.event_date <= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', uw.week2_sunday)
  GROUP BY uw.user_pseudo_id, uw.cohort_monday
)
SELECT 
  cohort_monday,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) as retention_rate
FROM user_retained
WHERE cohort_monday >= '2018-07-09' 
  AND cohort_monday <= '2018-09-17'
GROUP BY cohort_monday
ORDER BY cohort_monday

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    ep.value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name AS campaign_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
       UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key = 'ga_session_id'
  GROUP BY ga_session_id, traffic_source.medium, traffic_source.source, traffic_source.name
),
session_channels AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')
      ) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
      ) OR (medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
      ) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
      ) OR (medium = 'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
      ) OR (LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN (source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms') THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN (medium LIKE '%push' OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*mobile.*') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*notification.*')) THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM session_channels
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 10

      WHEN (LOWER(source) LIKE '%alibaba%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%amazon%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%google shopping%'

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    MAX(IF(ep.key = 'ga_session_id', CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING), NULL)) as session_id,
    MAX(IF(ep.key = 'page_location', ep.value.string_value, NULL)) as page_location

  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY event_timestamp
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    page_location,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) as num_segments,
    LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(3)]) as seg4_lower,
    LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(4)]) as seg5_lower,
    LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]) as last_seg_lower,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]) NOT LIKE '%+%' AND (LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(3)]) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
          OR LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(4)]) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'))
      THEN 'PLP'
      WHEN LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)]) LIKE '%+%' AND (LOWER(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(3)]) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')

      THEN 'PDP'

    END as view_type

valid_views AS (

),
session_has_pdp AS (

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_views v JOIN session_has_pdp s ON v.session_id = s.session_id WHERE v.view_type = 'PLP') as plp_views_in_sessions_with_pdp,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_views v JOIN session_has_pdp s ON v.session_id = s.session_id WHERE v.view_type = 'PLP'),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_views WHERE view_type = 'PLP')

WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) as cohort_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    cu.user_pseudo_id,
    cu.cohort_date,
    e.event_name as quickplay_event_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cu.user_pseudo_id ORDER BY e.event_timestamp, e.event_date) as rn
  FROM cohort_users cu
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e 
    ON cu.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    ufq.user_pseudo_id,
    ufq.quickplay_event_type,
    ufq.cohort_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN e2.event_name = 'session_start' 
      AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e2.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(ufq.cohort_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY)
      AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e2.event_date) <= DATE_ADD(ufq.cohort_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
    THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM user_first_quickplay ufq
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e2 
    ON ufq.user_pseudo_id = e2.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE ufq.rn = 1
  GROUP BY ufq.user_pseudo_id, ufq.quickplay_event_type, ufq.cohort_date
)
SELECT quickplay_event_type, 
       COUNT(*) as total_users,
       SUM(retained) as retained_users,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)) as retention_rate
FROM user_retention
GROUP BY quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate

WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'

),
all_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_name AS initial_quickplay_type,
    e.event_timestamp
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    initial_quickplay_type,
    event_timestamp AS first_quickplay_timestamp
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      user_pseudo_id,
      initial_quickplay_type,
      event_timestamp,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
    FROM all_quickplay
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
retained_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fp.user_pseudo_id, fp.initial_quickplay_type
  FROM first_quickplay fp
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fp.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name = fp.initial_quickplay_type
    AND e.event_timestamp >= fp.first_quickplay_timestamp + (14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000000)
)
SELECT 
  fp.initial_quickplay_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fp.user_pseudo_id) AS total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id) AS retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT fp.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) AS retention_rate_pct
FROM first_quickplay fp
LEFT JOIN retained_users r
  ON fp.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
  AND fp.initial_quickplay_type = r.initial_quickplay_type
GROUP BY fp.initial_quickplay_type
ORDER BY fp.initial_quickplay_type

WITH first_open_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(event_timestamp) + 8 * 3600 * 1000000)) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    foc.user_pseudo_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.event_timestamp >= foc.first_open_ts + 86400000000  
           AND e.event_timestamp < foc.first_open_ts + 691200000000  
      THEN 1
      WHEN e.event_timestamp >= foc.first_open_ts + 691200000000  
           AND e.event_timestamp < foc.first_open_ts + 1209600000000  
      THEN 2
      WHEN e.event_timestamp >= foc.first_open_ts + 1209600000000  
           AND e.event_timestamp < foc.first_open_ts + 1814400000000  
      THEN 3
    END as week_num
  FROM first_open_cohort foc
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON foc.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180831' AND '20181003'
),
retention_data AS (
  SELECT 
    week_num,
    COUNT(*) as retained_users
  FROM user_retention
  WHERE week_num IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY week_num
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rd.week_num = 1 THEN rd.retained_users END), 358) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rd.week_num = 2 THEN rd.retained_users END), 358) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rd.week_num = 3 THEN rd.retained_users END), 358) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_data rd

WITH first_openers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(user_first_touch_timestamp) as first_touch_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180930'
    AND user_first_touch_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(user_first_touch_timestamp))) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-30'
),
uninstallers AS (
  SELECT fo.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(fo.first_touch_ts)) as first_open_date,
    MIN(DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp))) as uninstall_date
  FROM first_openers fo
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fo.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY fo.user_pseudo_id, fo.first_touch_ts
),
uninstallers_within_7 AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id
  FROM uninstallers
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(uninstall_date, first_open_date, DAY) <= 7
),
crashers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.user_pseudo_id
  FROM uninstallers_within_7 u
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON u.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name = 'app_exception'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM uninstallers_within_7 u
LEFT JOIN crashers c ON u.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id
